landmark:donate-band.value: Moved .donate-band div inside <main>, right after the last <section>, instead of leaving it as a sibling between </main> and <footer>.
landmark:donate-band.rationale: The donate call-to-action is part of the primary page content, not header/footer chrome, so it belongs inside the main landmark to satisfy the 'region' rule without altering visual layout or content order.

alt-style:pet-avatar-illustrations.value: "Cartoon portrait of [Name], a [color/notable feature] [species] [wearing a [color] collar, if present]"
alt-style:pet-avatar-illustrations.rationale: Pet card images are decorative-illustration avatars carrying identity info not otherwise stated (color, breed cues, collar); concise consistent phrasing avoids redundant 'image of' and matches the informative-image style used across the adoption grid.

label-style:field-name-div-to-label.value: Converted `.field-name` divs into `<label class="field-name" for="...">` elements associated via id, rather than adding aria-label, to preserve visible styling and satisfy WCAG 3.3.2.
label-style:field-name-div-to-label.rationale: Nearby text already visually served as a label; converting it to a real <label> keeps the design identical while fixing the missing accessible name.

widget:consent-checkbox-div-to-input.value:
Replaced `
...
` with a native `` pair, restyled via CSS (appearance:none on .box, .consent label overrides for font-weight/size/color) to preserve the original visual appearance exactly.
widget:consent-checkbox-div-to-input.rationale: The page has no JavaScript, so the fake role="checkbox" div had no keyboard/state behavior to preserve; per guidance the native element is the correct fix over patching in aria-checked, and it also gives real keyboard/form functionality that was previously missing entirely.

color:#8ab98f-on-#ffffff.rationale: Original brand green #8ab98f on white only achieved 2.23:1 contrast for the .pet-age text; darkening to #4e8254 (same hue, deltaL 0.225) reaches 4.52:1, meeting WCAG AA 4.5:1 for normal text while preserving the brand green look.
